# Informed isometry-preparation study

The operator-arrow study exposed the previously recorded Iso-root/Unit profile
limit. This study follows inspection of the existing native instrument,
preparation, readout and source-event paths, including the retained formal
empty-readout calibration. It is informed repository development, not a blind
model benchmark. Codex authored it; exact deployed model/sampling is unavailable.

Desired existing-source programs prepare zero, retain scalar phase and quantum
Unit/reference frames, and call ordinary preparation helpers. Negative sources
must reject false effect assertions, lost/aliased owners and Unit/Bits0 type
substitution. The pure scalar control should remain unchanged. All projects have
explicit schema-2 edition-2026 manifests and at most one physical input qubit.

The intended independent equations are alpha -> alpha|0>, omega alpha ->
omega alpha|0>, and |b> -> |b,b> for controlled preparation, with coefficients
and arbitrary external-reference components preserved. omega = exp(i*pi/4).
Checking source/IR is distinct from exact requested equations and small complex
execution oracles. No probability-only test or round trip establishes these
equations. Native acceptance, source-event replay and full source preservation
remain separate claims.

The proposed implementation uses already checked zero preparation, a pure
graph and an empty readout. A singleton empty outcome is transport machinery;
it cannot supply an Observe fact, hidden measurement, sampling access, external
unitarity or a new quantum semantic primitive. No native definition, protected
meaning, binding interpretation or guarantee is changed by the study. Broader
QS/PR/quantitative RS and EXACT duties remain pending.
